title: The Antarctic Treaty says Antarctica shall be used exclusively for peaceful purposes
summary: The 1959 Antarctic Treaty reserves Antarctica for peaceful purposes.
body: The Antarctic Treaty says it is in the interest of all mankind that Antarctica shall continue forever to be used exclusively for peaceful purposes and shall not become the scene or object of international discord. The sentence is the treaty's purpose clause.
